description_en: Create a power generation prediction job.
description_zh: 创建发电功率预测任务
kebab_example: aliyun brain-industrial create-power-forecast-job --device-type solarInverter --history-data RunTime=2025-02-12_00:00:00 Value=1.0 --freq FIFTEEN_MIN --duration 1 --system-type solar --run-date 2025-02-12 --time-zone Asia/Shanghai --model-version latest --location Latitude=40.027 Longitude=120.042 Altitude=10.123 --business-key stationA --forecast-horizon DAY_AHEAD --data-mode FULL --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePowerForecastJob

parameters.help_en:
Device type. The supported device types for each systemType are:  

System Type: Device Type  

solar: solarInverter -- Photovoltaic inverter  
wind: windTurbine -- Wind turbine generator
parameters.help_zh:
设备类型，每个systemType支持的设备类型有：

系统类型：设备类型

solar: solarInverter --光伏逆变器
wind: windTurbine --风电发电机
parameters.name: device_type

fields.help_en: Every {freq} minutes, formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss". The data frequency must snap to the freq field.
fields.help_zh: 每{freq}分钟，"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"， 数据频率需与freq字段对齐
fields.name: run_time

parameters.help_en: Historical load data. Requires 90 days of historical data.
parameters.help_zh: 历史负荷，需要90天的历史数据
parameters.name: history_data

parameters.help_en:
Default is 15 min; must match the frequency of the historyData; enumeration values:  

FIFTEEN_MIN: 15 minutes  
FIVE_MIN: 5 minutes  
ONE_HOUR: 1 hour  
ONE_DAY: 1 day
parameters.help_zh:
默认15min；需要与historyData的数据频率一致；枚举值：

FIFTEEN_MIN: 15分钟
FIVE_MIN: 5分钟
ONE_HOUR: 1小时
ONE_DAY: 1天
parameters.name: freq

parameters.help_en:
Prediction duration in days, starting from and including the run date.  

Optional. Default value is 1 day.
parameters.help_zh:
从运行日(含)开始, 预测时长（单位：天）。

非必填，默认1天
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
System type. Supported system types include:  

solar: Photovoltaic  
wind: Wind power
parameters.help_zh:
系统类型，支持的系统类型有：

solar: 光伏
wind: 风电
parameters.name: system_type

parameters.help_en: Run date, accurate to the day, in "yyyy-MM-dd" format.
parameters.name: run_date

parameters.help_en: Time zone. The default is Asia/Shanghai (Shanghai time zone).
parameters.name: time_zone

parameters.help_en: Version number of the model. Default is latest.
parameters.help_zh: 模型对应的版本号，默认为latest
parameters.name: model_version

fields.help_en: Altitude, accurate to three decimal places. Default value is 10
fields.help_zh: 海拔高度，精度到小数点后3位，默认值为10
fields.name: altitude

fields.help_en: Latitude, accurate to three decimal places
fields.help_zh: 纬度，精度到小数点后3位
fields.name: latitude

fields.help_en: Longitude, accurate to three decimal places
fields.help_zh: 经度，精度到小数点后3位
fields.name: longitude

parameters.help_en: Location information, including latitude and longitude.
parameters.name: location

parameters.help_en: Business key, such as a site name or ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务键，如场站名称编号
parameters.name: business_key

parameters.help_en:
Forecast time horizon, enumeration values:  
DAY_AHEAD: Day-ahead forecast  
INTRADAY: Intraday forecast
parameters.help_zh:
预测时间尺度，枚举值：
DAY_AHEAD：日前预测
INTRADAY：日内预测
parameters.name: forecast_horizon

parameters.help_en:
Data mode for this invocation, enumeration values:  
FULL: Full data (uses only the data passed in this invocation)  
INCREMENTAL: Incremental data (automatically associates and uses data from previous invocations with the same BusinessKey)
parameters.help_zh:
本次调用的数据模式，枚举值：
FULL：全量数据（仅使用本次调用中传递的数据）
INCREMENTAL：增量数据（自动关联使用历史调用中相同BusinessKey的数据）
parameters.name: data_mode

Completed.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is completed. Valid values:  
True: The current Job has been executed.  
False: The current Job is still running.
Completed.description_zh:
操作是否完成，取值范围： 
True：当前Job已经执行完成。 
False：当前Job还在执行中
Completed.title_en: 操作是否完成，取值范围： True：当前Job已经执行完成。 False：当前Job还在执行中。
Completed.title_zh: 操作是否完成，取值范围： True：当前Job已经执行完成。 False：当前Job还在执行中。

Error.description_zh: 当前操作异常或者失败时的错误信息
Error.title_en: 当前操作异常或者失败时的错误信息
Error.title_zh: 当前操作异常或者失败时的错误信息

JobType.description_en:
Task Type, enumeration values:  
LoadForecast: Load prediction.  
PowerForecast: Power prediction.  
EssOptStrategy: Stored energy optimization.
JobType.description_zh:
计算任务类型，枚举值：
LoadForecast：负荷预测。
PowerForecast：功率预测。
EssOptStrategy：储能优化
JobType.title_en: 计算任务类型，枚举值：LoadForecast  PowerForecast
JobType.title_zh: 计算任务类型，枚举值：LoadForecast  PowerForecast

Status.description_en:
Task Status, enumeration values:  
RUNNING: running.  
SUCCESS: Succeeded.  
FAIL: failed.

任务状态，枚举值：
RUNNING：运行中。
SUCCESS：运行成功。
FAIL：运行失败
Status.title_en: 任务状态，枚举值： RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAIL
Status.title_zh: 任务状态，枚举值： RUNNING, SUCCESS, FAIL
